GeneDef.label: Marked Virus Immunity
GeneDef.description: Complete immunity to the Marked Virus. This gene prevents infection from all Marked Virus exposure and improves immunity gain.

GeneDef.label: Marked Virus Resistance
GeneDef.description: Unusual immune markers reduce the chance of contracting the Marked Virus by 75% after direct exposure.

GeneDef.label: aggression marker
GeneDef.description: A dangerous neurological expression pattern seen in late-stage Marked Virus mutations. It increases movement speed and melee capability at the cost of social stability.
